title: check.py's lexical code scan drops every citation of a file that holds a nested-quote f-string
goal: code_comment_lines reads a file holding a Python 3.12 nested-quote f-string such as f"{d["it's"]}" as ast and tokenize did: its comment lines are kept and a # inside the f-string is no comment

run: import sys,tempfile,os;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import check;p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'x.py');open(p,'w').write('x = f\x22{d[\x22it\x27s\x22]}\x22\n# c\n');sys.exit(0 if check.code_comment_lines(p) else 1)
